item.title: Why is Nick Eh 30 facing massive backlash? Transphobia allegations rise after Fortnite’s Harry Potter leak
item.description: Fortnite creator Nick Eh 30 faces transphobia accusations. This follows his removal of a post about a rumored Harry Potter collaboration. Social media users called out his actions as hypocritical. Nick Eh 30 has not publicly commented on the allegations. He continues to stream and tease upcoming Fortnite Chapter 7 updates.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: “My mom is kinda homeless”: IShowSpeed meets the Fortnite kid behind his most famous meme after five years
item.description: A funny, emotional moment from streamer IShowSpeed's 2021 Fortnite game became a viral meme. The clip featured a young player named Acey Daddy discussing his mother's homelessness. Years later, in 2025, IShowSpeed and Acey Daddy reunited to recreate the scene. Acey Daddy confirmed his mother was now financially stable. The reunion brought back fond memories for fans.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: 'Vile creature, worst thing on Earth': Nancy Pelosi unleashes scathing attack on Donald Trump
item.description: Nancy Pelosi, speaking to CNN, called President Trump a "vile creature" and "the worst thing on the face of the Earth," citing his alleged disregard for the Constitution. The former House speaker also stated she would announce her decision on seeking another congressional term after Tuesday's elections, emphasizing her focus on achieving a significant Democratic victory.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: NYC mayoral race: Donald Trump threatens to cut federal funds; warns of ‘total disaster’ if 'communist' Zohran Mamdani wins election
item.description: Donald Trump threatened to withhold federal funds from New York City if Zohran Mamdani, whom he labeled a Communist, wins the mayoral election. Trump predicted economic disaster under Mamdani's leadership and urged New Yorkers to vote for former Governor Andrew Cuomo instead.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Elon Musk backs Andrew Cuomo in NYC race; says voting for Sliwa would only help Mamdani
item.description: Elon Musk has endorsed Andrew Cuomo for New York City mayor, urging voters to reject Zohran Mamdani, whom Musk labeled 'socialist.' This backing aligns Musk with other billionaires and Donald Trump, who also expressed preference for Cuomo over Mamdani. Cuomo emphasizes experience and fiscal discipline, while Mamdani advocates for taxing the wealthy and expanding public services.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: English test crackdown bars over 7,000 truckers across US; Indian-origin drivers among most affected
item.description: Thousands of truck drivers, particularly those of Indian and Latino origin, are being removed from service after failing new English proficiency tests. Industry leaders warn of discrimination and a looming driver shortage, while federal officials cite safety concerns following fatal accidents. Critics argue the policy unfairly targets immigrants and lacks data to support its safety claims.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Where is Zohran Mamdani's wife Rama Duwaji? No post for husband on social media, no joint television appearance
item.description: Rama Duwaji, wife of mayoral candidate Zohran Mamdani, maintained a deliberate distance from his campaign, opting for a background role. While she supported him privately and contributed to campaign aesthetics, Duwaji avoided public political engagements and interviews throughout the election cycle. The 28-year-old artist did not make any social media posts seeking votes for her husband, did not do any joint television appearances agree to do any magazine profiles.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Is Nancy Pelosi quitting politics? Democrats brace as 85-year-old former House Speaker prepares to exit stage
item.description: Democrats are anticipating Nancy Pelosi's potential retirement. The long-serving Congresswoman may announce her future plans after Tuesday's elections. Her departure would mark the end of a significant era in American politics. Two Democrats are already campaigning for her San Francisco seat. Pelosi's focus remains on the 'Yes on 50' ballot measure.

item.title: Viral video of woman in bikini dancing in giant Martini glass at Trump’s Mar-a-Lago party stirs row: ‘Full Epstein Island vibes’
item.description: Donald Trump's Mar-a-Lago Halloween party, featuring half-naked dancers in a giant martini glass, drew sharp criticism as millions lost food aid during the government shutdown. Critics called the opulent "Great Gatsby" themed event "tone deaf" and compared it to "Epstein Island," highlighting the stark contrast with national struggles.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Kash Patel's singer girlfriend says she's a political commentator amid row over her 'sleeper cells in US' comment
item.description: "I’ve been in commentary and op-eds a long time. The Biden admin let terrorists over the border. Some common sense and maybe watching the original video of my news hit (which I did as part of my own job relating to the border) might be helpful before you contribute," Kash Patel's girlfriend Alexis Wilkins wrote amid row over her 'sleeper cells' comment.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: RaKai’s Halloween costume controversy: What really happened during the livestream?
item.description: Popular streamer RaKai sparked controversy with his "white-face" Halloween costume, inspired by the movie White Chicks. While some defended it as a pop culture reference, others deemed it racially insensitive. RaKai, 16, dismissed criticism, asserting the right to dress as anyone and claiming negativity is inevitable. This incident follows his previous Twitch bans.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Is Nicki Minaj part of MAGA movement? Rapper's support for Donald Trump and Elon Musk sparks claims
item.description: Nicki Minaj has sparked debate by publicly thanking Donald Trump for his remarks on religious persecution in Nigeria and expressing support for Elon Musk. Her posts have led to speculation about her political alignment, particularly with figures associated with the MAGA movement, drawing both praise and criticism.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Dubai racing carnival is back! Where to get tickets, VIP access, paddock parties, and key race dates revealed
item.description: Dubai's glamorous racing carnival returns to Meydan on November 7, 2025, promising 16 thrilling race meetings culminating in the Dubai World Cup on March 28, 2026. Racegoers can anticipate world-class competition, high fashion, and vibrant entertainment, with diverse ticketing options from general admission to exclusive VIP packages.

item.title: Saudi preacher Ayedh Al-Qarni responds after uproar over viral remarks on death and funeral rituals
item.description: Prominent Islamic preacher Ayedh Al-Qarni has ignited a wave of online debate following a viral video in which he made provocative remarks about death and how families behave after a loved one’s passing. The comments, which many interpreted as insensitive, sparked both outrage and support, eventually prompting Al-Qarni to issue a public clarification.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Indian-origin truck driver Jashanpreet Singh was not drunk, claims toxicology report; cleared of DUI charges
item.description: A significant development in the 10 Freeway crash case sees Indian-origin truck driver Jashanpreet Singh cleared of DUI charges, with toxicology reports confirming no substances in his system. While initially accused of drunk driving, amended charges now focus on gross negligence and reckless driving. The Sikh community also raised concerns about his court appearance without his turban.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Dated both Katy Perry and Justin Trudeau? American DJ Diplo makes wild claim; social media asks 'At the same time?'
item.description: DJ Diplo sparked online buzz by humorously claiming he dated both Katy Perry and Justin Trudeau. While his Trudeau comment was a joke, his past brief romance with Perry is confirmed. Perry and Trudeau have recently made their relationship public, with paparazzi photos capturing their affectionate moments in Paris.
item.dc:creator: TOI Trending Desk
